produced_at_commit.resolved_when: at process start, when Python bound the modules this run executed -- NOT at artefact assembly, which is a later tree
produced_at_commit.why_this_is_here: This run takes hours and the tree moves under it. A consumer that wants to publish these counts needs to know which code drew them, and no diff between two artefacts can supply that.

world_identity.what_this_identifies: the departure LEVEL the world was running at -- `year_level_anchor` for every year inside the published switching record, fitted and declared alike. Two runs sharing this digest ran over the same departure surface; two that do not are different worlds however close their timestamps, and no figure from one bounds a figure from the other.

what_each_count_selects.billing_accounts_settled_in_window: every billing account with at least one settlement record anywhere in the window, dual-fuel legs collapsed, ceased or not
what_each_count_selects.accounts_at_end_of_window: MISLEADING KEY: not the book at the end. The VALUED subset — accounts with a renewal point, still on supply at the window's edge, and with an observed margin. Smaller than the book by the accounts that could not be valued.

book_identity.why_this_is_here: So a reader can tell WHICH book a figure describes without diffing a commit date against a run timestamp -- the defect logged as WORKER_FINDING_THE_AB_ARTEFACT_CANNOT_NAME_THE_BOOK_IT_RAN_ON_2026-08-26, raised against this file. The filename is not the control: `value_cycle_ab_resi.json` in fact served resi AND SME, so the one piece of provenance a reader had was misleading.

what_this_is: Which households actually take each re-drawable draw on the full window, and how the value arm's priced roster cuts them. ONE pass with PASS-THROUGH recorders on both symbols -- nothing is re-seeded, so this is the base world and `selection_gbp_this_pass` is the base run's own figure.
how_to_read_this: `keys.<key>.except_leg_would_refuse` is the whole result for that key: true means a floor leg keyed to it CANNOT measure the rest of the book on this book, because the complement of the priced roster never takes that draw. It is a fact about the instrument and not about the world, and it gets WORSE as the arm prices more of the book, because the roster swallows the complement it would re-draw.
